paragraphs.text: The lift in block C will be out of use from Monday 6 May for approximately four days. Engineers will work between 8 am and 6 pm and will keep the stairwell clear at all times.
Residents who cannot use the stairs should contact the office before 3 May; help with shopping and bin bags will be arranged. The lift in block B is available to all residents during the works.

items.quote: out of use from Monday 6 May for approximately four days
items.prompt: The lift will be out of use for about four days.

explanation.kk: «approximately four days» — шамамен төрт күн → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «approximately four days» — шамамен төрт күн → TRUE.

items.quote: Engineers will work between 8 am and 6 pm

explanation.en: Work runs from 8 am to 6 pm, not at night → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Работы идут с 8 до 18, не ночью → FALSE.

items.quote: should contact the office before 3 May
items.prompt: Residents needing help should contact the office in advance.

explanation.en: They must contact the office before 3 May, that is in advance → TRUE.
explanation.kk: 3 мамырға дейін хабарласу керек, яғни алдын ала → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Обратиться нужно до 3 мая, то есть заранее → TRUE.

items.quote: The lift in block C will be out of use
items.prompt: The repairs are needed because of an accident.

explanation.en: The reason for the repairs is not given → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Причина ремонта не названа → NOT GIVEN.
